Hi Tessa / Karhtik,

Thanks again for getting us the updated MSA and Order Form. Our legal team reviewed the redlines and we have two signing logistics items that are gating our execution on the Novamed side: 

1) Signatory authority evidence — For Novamed (foreign subsidiary), we need a scanned board resolution or a POA confirming that the person signing the MSA has authority to bind the entity. Our GC insists on the document uploaded to the signing envelope before the signature step.

2) Witness requirement — Because the signing will happen for a Cayman-registered subsidiary, our compliance team requires an independent witness step (name + email captured; witness does not need to sign the whole doc, just witness block).

Can Redwood set up the DocuSign envelope so that: (a) the Novamed signer is prompted to upload the signatory evidence before they complete their signature, and (b) the witness is included as a required recipient (routing after the primary signer) so the witness attestation is captured in the audit trail?

Also, please confirm we will receive a single "final clean" PDF (no markup) with the DocuSign audit trail attached and that Redwood will hold the envelope from sending to finance until we confirm the signatory docs are uploaded.

Attaching our annotated requirements and the final order form for reference.

Attachments: Novamed_Signature_Requirements_20280712.pdf (pdf), OrderForm_Final_20280712.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Shelley Park
Director, Procurement — Novamed

Appreciate the clear checklist. We can absolutely accommodate both asks. Plan below: 

- DocuSign routing: sequential envelope. Step 1: Novamed signer (required) — will be configured to require an upload field for "Signatory Evidence (board resolution / POA)" before the signature button activates. Step 2: Independent witness — required recipient, routed after signer. Step 3: Redwood contract ops (for internal countersign if any last-minute admin sigs are needed).

- Final clean copy: we'll produce the consolidated clean PDF (MSA + Order Form) with the DocuSign audit trail appended as a separate PDF page set. We'll also deposit the executed PDF and audit history into our contracts Drive folder and send you a link.

- Hold instructions: we'll hold the envelope from auto-releasing to our finance team until we confirm the signatory evidence is present. If the evidence is missing when the envelope reaches the signer, DocuSign will block completion (we'll set it up).

Marissa / Rishi — can legal ops confirm: (1) wording for the envelope upload field we should require, (2) whether we should add any additional attestations for the witness (e.g., witness email verification), and (3) whether finance needs to countersign the Order Form inline or after the MSA executes?

I will prepare the envelope and a brief "how-to" email for Novamed with screenshots for the upload flow.

Best,
Tessa
